summary: I was responsible for the application end to end, in a Ruby on Rails monolith, working with the CTO and Product from defining each feature through to delivery.
highlights: Ranked candidate panels for employers, dynamic filters and forms for students, and an internal dashboard to configure both.
Backend, frontend, data modelling, testing, deployments, and the product's infrastructure.
I mentored, coordinated, and managed a team of two developers: one junior and one mid.
